summary: Dependency resolved from unpinned personal GitHub repo
details: package.json declares the `libsignal` dependency as `github:RahmadTenpoles/libsignal-node`, a mutable git reference to a personal GitHub account rather than a registry version range or a pinned commit SHA. On `npm install`, npm clones whatever bytes currently live at that repository's HEAD and runs any lifecycle scripts contained in them, with no version pin and no integrity check. The referenced account is unrelated to the mainline Baileys libsignal maintainer (`WhiskeySockets/libsignal-node`) and is not the publisher of this package, so whoever controls `RahmadTenpoles` controls code that will execute inside the installer's environment on every install of raiden-baileys@2.1.3.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
